content: What do you want to eat today?
I feel like having some dumplings. Let's go out to eat.
No need! I know how to make dumplings. Let's do it from scratch. Can you give me a hand in the kitchen? I don't think I can finish everything by myself.
Of course. What do you want me to do?
Just trim vegetables for cooking. I will cut up the meat.
I can do that. And I would like to make dumplings later.
Yeah, you are my good helper, Steven.
